result.description:
Location: Kangaroo Point, QLD, 4169
Full-Time: Immediate start
Reports to: Centre Manager & ECT
Job Title: Child Care Worker
Salary range: $79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About This Role:
Our client is a well-established early learning provider committed to nurturing children's growth through play-based learning and holistic development. With purpose-built facilities and a team of dedicated educators, they create warm, inclusive environments where children feel safe to explore, learn and thrive. Their philosophy emphasizes emotional wellbeing, creativity and foundational skill-building during these crucial early years.
We're seeking a nurturing Childcare Worker to join their team. This role goes beyond supervision - you'll actively contribute to children's developmental milestones while fostering their curiosity through engaging, age-appropriate experiences.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Program Delivery & Child Development:
• Design and implement stimulating educational programs aligned with the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF)
• Facilitate intentional teaching moments through play-based activities including storytelling, music, art and sensory exploration
• Observe and document children's progress to support individual learning goals and share insights with families
• Guide social-emotional development by modelling positive behaviour and conflict resolution strategies

Daily Care & Wellbeing:
• Maintain impeccable hygiene standards including nappy changing, toileting assistance and mealtime supervision
• Create predictable routines that provide children with emotional security while allowing flexibility for spontaneous learning
• Conduct thorough safety checks of indoor/outdoor environments and resources before activities
• Administer first aid when required and follow health management plans for children with additional needs

Family & Community Engagement:
• Build trusting relationships with families through daily conversations and formal progress updates
• Collaborate with room leaders to create displays that make children's learning visible to parents
• Participate in community events and centre initiatives that strengthen family connections

Compliance & Professionalism:
• Maintain current working with children check - first aid certification and relevant qualifications
• Contribute to quality improvement processes through reflective practice
• Attend staff meetings and professional development sessions to enhance practice

Skills & Requirements:
• Certificate III or Diploma in Early Childhood Education & Care (or ACECQA-approved equivalent)
• Proven 1-year minimum experience in long day care or similar setting.
• Demonstrated knowledge of EYLF and National Quality Standards
• Genuine passion for early childhood development with endless patience and creativity
• Current First Aid, Asthma & Anaphylaxis certificates as well as proof of vaccination
• Working with children rights
• Police check
• Strong communication skills to engage with children, colleagues and families
• References from previous employers

Why Apply?
This is more than a job - it's an opportunity to shape young lives in an environment that values educator wellbeing as much as child development. You'll receive:

• Above-award wages for qualified candidates
• Paid professional development opportunities
• Supportive leadership team with realistic expectations
• Purpose-built facilities with quality resources

If you're ready to make your mark in early childhood education with an organisation that values your expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

How to Apply:
Submit your resume and cover letter addressing your experience with the EYLF and your approach to play-based learning. Successful applicants will require valid working rights and must pass background checks.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

result.description: SUBA ENGINEERING PTY LTD  We are seeking a Technical Manufacturing Support Engineer to be involved in the production of Suba's in-house designed products, ensuring a high quality of workmanship is maintained, and goods are produced in a timely manner. In addition, under the general supervision of the Technical Support Manager, you will help with providing after-sales support for the products as required.    Benefits   Task & responsibilities  The main duties of the role include:  In house production   To work on production of Suba in-house designed products  To utilize Sheetmetal working skills in the production of Suba in-house designed and manufactured goods:  Designing, drawing new templates and utilising existing templates  Cutting metals using provided templates and available tools necessary to meet with quality control targets  Forming metals into required shape utilising available joining tools  Assembling metal parts to encase technical/mechanical/electrical componentry to produce end product  Applying correct finishing product/technique to manufactured products as per quality control targets  To ensure all raw production materials are available and re-stocked as necessary to ensure smooth continuous production  To maintain systems whereby goods are produced in a timely manner.  To maintain Suba’s highest quality of workmanship possible in accordance with production directives  To raise any issues that occur during production that will have an impact on the finished item  To assist in researching latest technologies so goods can be adapted to incorporate the latest features  To co-ordinate supporting staff to ensure production runs smoothly and timely   Service activities   To have all the tools and other necessary equipment available and in proper working order.  To work efficiently within the allocated work area in a professional manner.  Technical support  To investigate causes of technical problems and to find and recommend remedies.  To be pro-active in establishing improvements to levels of preventive maintenance, and future re-designs to improve overall products manufactured  To provide service / maintenance to manufactured products  General  Prepare monthly and weekly plans to keep all areas updated on Suba’s manufacturing activities  Attend any training meetings as set down  Be aware of company policy and support the same.  Work with integrity and promote Suba’s interests within the industry.  Works as a member of the manufacturing and technical support team, and as such lend support willingly to help within the team and also in the broader organisation as required.   Conducts tests of mechanical systems, collects and analyses data, and assembles and installs mechanical assemblies in support of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists.   preparing drawings, plans and designs for mechanical engineering work under the direction of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists  assisting Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists in the design of mechanical equipment and plant  selecting tools and equipment  assembling and installing new and modified mechanical assemblies, components, machine tools and controls, and hydraulic power systems  estimating material costs and quantities, and machine requirements  performing and directing field and laboratory tests  collecting and analysing data, carrying out complex computations and preparing diagrams  organising and supervising inspection and maintenance of machines and plant  ensuring that designs and finished work are within specifications, regulations and contract provisions    Qualification & experience  You will possess a relevant diploma level qualification or at least three years of highly relevant employment experience to substitute.  In depth technical knowledge of manufacturing processes involving sheet metal working to manufacture and design Suba in-house products. Good technical and practical background in working with metal is essential. Good communications skills and attention to detail.  About Company     We are a local supplier of production solutions for the Electronics Manufacturing and Wire Processing Industry. We are proud to represent in Australasia the very best of the world’s suppliers and manufacturers of equipment for the electronics manufacturing industry.
